vectors.name: synthesized_defaults_v0
vectors.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

vectors.name: four_distinct_int64s
vectors.why: Every field is an int64, so an all-defaults vector cannot tell them apart or catch a transposition. Distinct values pin the order.
